_note: Template for config/run-<model>.json. Copy it, fill in the paths on your box, and run ./run.sh <model>. The Build tab writes this file for you when it builds an engine for a quant: exe points at that engine in engine/engine_<quant>/, the log goes in logs/, and any runtime data the build ships is copied next to the engine. Paths are absolute because the engine is started as a separate process; nothing here is read unless a run config names it.
